name: reconcile
summary: The gate every derived figure passes through. Arithmetic over an INCOMPLETE transaction list produces a plausible number rather than an error, so reconciliation is a TYPE: only a passing reconcile can mint a ReconciledLedger, and coverage is the LEAST covered account. No tolerance — money is integers, so a one-cent gap is a real row missing, doubled or mis-signed.
